say:1:1630169001:1.text: I came to the Lyceum to become a great mage. That was the dream...
say:1:1630169001:1.source_cn: 我来到莱希拉姆，是为了追求成为伟大魔法师的梦想……
say:1:1630169001:1.male: I came to the Lyceum to become a great mage. That was the dream...
say:1:1630169001:1.female: I came to the Lyceum to become a great mage. That was the dream...

say:2:1630169002:1.text: But the universe had other ideas. One tragic accident and poof—dream gone. So was I.
say:2:1630169002:1.source_cn: 但是我离开得太早了，早到我刚踏进校门的第三天就发生了意外。
say:2:1630169002:1.male: But the universe had other ideas. One tragic accident and poof—dream gone. So was I.
say:2:1630169002:1.female: But the universe had other ideas. One tragic accident and poof—dream gone. So was I.

say:3:1630169003:1.text: Never even got to ask a question in class. Never got to cast a spell beside the great mages...
say:3:1630169003:1.source_cn: 我还没来得及跟莱希拉姆的老师们请教，没来得及跟这些顶尖...
say:3:1630169003:1.male: Never even got to ask a question in class. Never got to cast a spell beside the great mages...
say:3:1630169003:1.female: Never even got to ask a question in class. Never got to cast a spell beside the great mages...

say:5:1630169005:1.text: Maybe I should've studied luck magic instead...
say:5:1630169005:1.source_cn: 也许，提升运气的魔法更适合我……
say:5:1630169005:1.male: Maybe I should've studied luck magic instead...
say:5:1630169005:1.female: Maybe I should've studied luck magic instead...
